content: Yutam idweř d ajeǧid n Yahuda
Yutam tuɣa ɣares xemsa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem seṭṭac n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Yaruca, yeǧis n Ṣaduq.
Netta igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, nican am mammec t igga babas Ɛuzziya, maca netta war yudif ca ɣar Zzawect Tameqqrant n SIDI. Řgens maca tuɣa ɛad ifsed ixef nnes aṭṭas.
Netta ibna Tawwart Yuɛřan n Taddart n SIDI. Uřa ɣar řḥiḍ n Ɛufil ibna aṭṭas.
Ibna tineddam di Temmurt n Idurar n Yahuda u deg izeɣran ibna lqelɛat d ṣṣumɛat.

Netta immneɣ ak-d ayt n Ɛammun u iɣřeb xasen, ařami ayt n Ɛammun ssiwḍen ɣares deg useggʷas nni ɛad mya talint n nnuqart d ɛecra-ařaf n ikuruten n irden d ɛecra-ařaf ikuruten n imendi. Uřa deg useggʷas wiss tnayen d wiss třata ssiwḍen ayt n Ɛammun ɣares man aya ɛawed.
Ammu i idweř Yutam ijhed, maɣar issewjed ibriden nnes zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nnes.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Yutam, d marra imenɣan i immneɣ d marra ibriden nnes, aqa ttwazemmemen deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda.
Tuɣa ɣares xemsa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem seṭṭac n iseggʷusa di Urcalim.
Yutam igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Netta ittwanḍeř di tendint n Dawud. Mmis Aḥaz idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
